_readme: FIAT PEOPLE - the three heads. 128 x 128 portraits to art/people/<slug>.png, in the fence's style (style_image res://art/people/fence.png, every style option on). Items.slug(name) is the file: the_carpet_man, the_manager, the_quartermaster. The run screen shows the face while the head is out; the game shows nothing where there is none.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_people_heads_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list). A job whose file exists is skipped; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of a heavy man in his fifties who ran a carpet warehouse before the collapse and runs the car park now: a fleece with the shop's name half unpicked, a flat cap, a face that has decided things, a roll of carpet tape on a lanyard, grey stubble, a kettle's steam behind him. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, overcast light. One person centred, filling the frame, no text, no border, plain dark background.

A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of a bank branch manager in his forties still in the suit, which fits: a clean collar, a tie done properly, a name badge with the name scratched off, hair combed with water, a face that is polite and will not help. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, strip-light pale. One person centred, filling the frame, no text, no border, plain dark background.

A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of an army quartermaster in his sixties, out of the army and still in it: issue jumper with the rank unpicked, a clipboard held like a weapon, reading glasses pushed up, a face that signs for everything. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, overcast light. One person centred, filling the frame, no text, no border, plain dark background.
